entries.purpose: GUI and headless classic map inspection with a pinned content identity catalog.
entries.current_usage: .github/workflows/check.yml runs its tests and pinned catalog verification.
entries.owner_milestone: M4 — Shared editor and scalable presentation
entries.replacement_command: atrinik-content check (planned by atrinik/content-toolkit#8); native UI integration belongs to atrinik/editor#11.
entries.licensing_method: Retain the complete map-checker-qt/ subtree under GPL-2.0-or-later until its replacement permits removal; do not treat the repository's MIT default as applying inside this scoped exception.
entries.safety: Retain checksum, traversal, link, size, atomic-install, and import-origin checks; keep CLI validation display-independent.
entries.verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s map-checker-qt/tests -v && python3 map-checker-qt/dependencies.py verify

entries.purpose: Split native debug symbols and symbolize classic crash traces.
entries.current_usage: Optional classic release/operator diagnostics; no replacement build or runtime imports these scripts.
entries.replacement_command: Use platform-native Go/Rust crash and symbol packaging in each replacement owner; these commands remain classic-only until final classic retirement.
entries.licensing_method: Apply the repository's MIT default only after the issue-22 provenance record proves the exact contributions; this does not change the GPL-2.0-or-later map-checker-qt/ exception.
entries.safety: Operate only on explicit build artifacts, preserve originals until verification, avoid shell-expanded broad paths, and redact sensitive paths from published traces.
entries.verification: Run against disposable classic release artifacts and verify build IDs, debug links, symbol lookup, and unchanged runtime behavior.
